author: Hyps
quote: One of the best games I have ever played and wanted in a game for a long time, ignore all the journalists and opinions about the game. Play it for yourself and see if the game is for you. Nowadays games will get hated on before it’s released. Do not listen to these horrible reviewers like ign. Amazing combat, world feels lively and so much content endless exploration. The story isnt that greta at the start but once you hit chapter 6 thats when it gets interesting. My only criticism for this game is the puzzle can sometimes be clunky when you trying to for example lit a symbol it sometimes wouldn't do it but overall the game is beautiful.
